provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Cranberry, Chapter 27 Zoning, as published on eCode360, with the Table of Authorized Accessory Uses (27 Attachment 3) and the Table of Authorized Principal Uses (27 Attachment 2)
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code CR0448): includes legislation through 06-05-2025. New Laws (7). Three amend Chapter 27: Ord. 2026-531 (animal rescue), 2026-533 (automobile wash rows in the principal use table, signs) and 2026-535 (drive-thru). None touches the ADU rows. Ordinances adopted between June 2025 and the New Laws list were not checked one by one. Read in the eCode360 print view and attachment PDFs in a browser. Currency gap: the code runs through 06-05-2025 and New Laws starts at Ord. 2026-529 (2026-06-25). An ordinance adopted from June 2025 to June 2026 that is neither codified nor listed cannot be seen. The definitions history ends at Ord. 2025-526 (4/24/2025).
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 06-05-2025. New Laws (7), three for Chapter 27, none about ADUs. Accessory use table marked Supp 14, May 2024.
checks: Two accessory uses are permitted by right (R) in the Table of Authorized Accessory Uses: 'Accessory dwelling unit' in R-1, R-2, R-3, SU-1 and SP-1, and 'Accessory dwelling quarters' in the same districts plus RMU
Accessory dwelling quarters: living space inside the house, connected internally, or in an addition. Not in an unattached structure (27-202)

Accessory dwelling unit: living space 'attached to the principal structure via a breezeway or the like that is no longer than 30 feet', with its own bathroom. 400 to 1,200 sq ft and at most 50% of the house floor area (27-202). A free-standing cottage is not allowed. The file records this breezeway unit under the detached_new form only so its size caps do not apply to the quarters
Only one accessory dwelling unit or accessory dwelling quarters per lot (27-202)
The code sets no owner-occupancy, family or rental rule for either form
Accessory buildings over 200 sq ft must meet the principal building yards (27-403.6.E(3), 27-404.6.E)
Parking: single-family detached dwellings need four spaces per dwelling unit. No ADU row (27-312)
Two-family and quad dwellings are allowed in R-2 and R-3 only within a planned residential development (Table of Authorized Principal Uses)

Community Character Development overlays CCD-1 and CCD Freedom A: no more than 10% of the single-family detached dwellings may have an ADU ('granny flat or mother-in-law suite') (27-506.7.B(3), 27-506.9.1). Other CCD sections allow 'An accessory dwelling unit as permitted by the Township Code' with no cap
The definitions also list 'Dwelling, carriage house', an apartment of up to 600 sq ft that may be in an outbuilding. No use table row names it
A single-family dwelling and customary accessory buildings may be built on a nonconforming lot in separate ownership (27-1002.1). The ADU rule does not require a conforming lot
Single-family detached dwellings are N in SU-1 and SP-1 (principal use table), so an ADU there needs an existing house
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Planning and Development, https://www.cranberrytownship.org/814/Planning-Development. Pending: no ADU amendment on the New Laws list. Review fixes 2026-11-11: breezeway proxy labelled, CCD 10% districts narrowed, similar-use note, R-3, SU-1, SP-1, RMU rows, no accessory height, no separation rule.

term.note: 'ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT: A residential accessory use'. 'GRANNY FLAT: See accessory dwelling unit.' 27-506 also says 'granny flat or mother-in-law suite'. Also 'accessory dwelling quarters' for a unit inside the house.

status.section: 27 Attachment 3, Table of Authorized Accessory Uses
status.note: Rows 'Accessory dwelling quarters' and 'Accessory dwelling unit': R (by right) in R-1, R-2, R-3, SU-1, SP-1.

path.note: 'Uses by right are those authorized uses for which a zoning approval will be issued by the Zoning Officer'. No hearing.

fallback_path.note: Other districts show N. Unlisted uses 'shall not be permitted', but 'Uses which are not specifically listed but are similar to a specifically listed use shall be permitted by conditional use in the same zoning district' (27-401.5). ADUs are listed, so this does not change the path. A lot that fails the definition limits needs a variance.

value.note: RMU: accessory dwelling quarters R, accessory dwelling unit N. Inside or an addition only.

district_paths.note: RMU allows only the internal form.

zoning_districts.note: ADU R in R-1, R-2, R-3, SU-1, SP-1. Accessory dwelling quarters R in those and RMU. N in C-1, C-2, C-3, BPK, I-L, PIC, TLI, MU.

building_types.note: Quarters are 'within a single-family structure'. Reading: a single-family detached house. Each listed district allows one single-family dwelling per lot.

existing_structure_only.note: 'creating living space'. New construction is allowed.

value.condition: The form shown as detached_new is the breezeway unit: the code treats it as attached 'via a breezeway or the like that is no longer than 30 feet', with its own bathroom. A free-standing cottage is not allowed.
RMU: only accessory dwelling quarters (inside or an addition). The accessory dwelling unit row is N.
Accessory dwelling quarters 'shall not be by an unattached residential structure'.
Accessory buildings over 200 sq ft meet the principal building yards.
CCD-1 and CCD Freedom A: at most 10% of the single-family detached dwellings in the development may have an ADU.
RMU: accessory structure or building setbacks are 2 ft from any property line.

types_allowed.note: Quarters: inside the house or an addition (internal, attached). ADU: the code calls it attached, 'attached to the principal structure via a breezeway or the like that is no longer than 30 feet'. It is recorded as detached_new only as a labelled proxy, so the 1,200 sq ft and 50% caps land on it and not on the quarters. A free-standing cottage is not allowed.

max_sqft.note: No cap for accessory dwelling quarters. The 1,200 sq ft cap is for the accessory dwelling unit.

max_sqft_accessory_building.note: 'shall not exceed 1,200 square gross feet for the accessory unit'. At least 400 sq ft.

max_share_accessory_building.note: 'no more than 50% of the gross floor area of the principal structure'.

min_sqft.note: The accessory dwelling unit needs at least 400 sq ft. No minimum for quarters.

max_height_ft.note: No separate accessory building height found for R-1 and R-2. The 35 ft district height applies.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'accessory buildings in excess of 200 square feet of building area must comply with the yard requirements for principal structures'. An ADU is at least 400 sq ft.

separation_ft.note: No separation rule between buildings on a lot. The unit is joined to the house by a breezeway of at most 30 ft.

accessory_height_applies.note: No accessory building height in the code for these districts. The district height applies (35 ft in R-1 and R-2).

owner_occupancy.note: No owner-occupancy rule in the definitions or the use table.

family_only.note: Living space 'for individuals'. No family or age rule.

occupancy.value: No rule on who may live there. One accessory dwelling unit or quarters per lot.

max_adus.note: 'Only one accessory dwelling unit or accessory dwelling quarters is allowed on any single lot'.

reading.value: Single-family detached dwellings need 4 spaces per dwelling unit. No ADU row. If the ADU is not a separate dwelling unit, the lot needs 4. If it counts as one, more, either 4 or 2.75 ('All other residential uses'). Ask the Zoning Officer.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'Where there is public sanitary sewer: 1.25 acres'. 1.5 acres without. Lot width 100 ft. One single-family dwelling per lot.
'Minimum Net Lot Area: 3/4 acre' with public sewer. One acre without. 85 ft wide.

setback_side_ft.note: 5 ft in the Fernway Plan of Lots.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'All other uses shall have a minimum lot size of 3/4 acre'. PRD uses follow Part 9.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 45 ft for any building or structure.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'Minimum net lot area: one acre'. 100 ft setback from an R district line. Single-family detached is N in SU-1.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 50 ft unless yards grow one foot for each two feet over 50.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'Minimum Net Lot Area: one acre'. Single-family detached is N in SP-1.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 50 ft unless yards grow one foot for each two feet over 50.
45 ft for any building or structure. 75 ft perimeter setback. Lot area by PRD rules (Part 9).
